definitions.explanation: Showing care and consideration for others. Describes a person or their behavior as warm and helpful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{親切|しんせつ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{親切|しんせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{教|おし}えてくれました→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
examples.english: They kindly showed me the way.

examples.japanese: ご{親切|しんせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ありがとう→ありがとう：00917_arigatou⟧ございます。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{親切|しんせつ}⟦すぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧、⟦{時々|ときどき}→時々：00600_tokidoki⟧⟦おせっかい→おせっかい：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}われる→思う：00492_omou⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: He's so kind that sometimes people think he's being nosy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧ばかり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{親切|しんせつ}にして⟦くれて→くれる：00724_kureru⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{助|たす}かった→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧。
examples.english: When I first came to Japan, the people around me were kind to me and it really helped.

notes:
{親切|しんせつ} is a na-adjective: {親切|しんせつ}な (before nouns), {親切|しんせつ}だ/です (predicate), {親切|しんせつ}じゃない (negative). The kanji literally mean 'close + cut' - the idea of being close enough to someone to help them. Can also be used as a noun: {親切|しんせつ} (kindness).

Related: {不親切|ふしんせつ} (unkind).
